notablePrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to any legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the legendary creature with Splinter Twin attached by tapping it, creating a copy of that creature with haste.
Put the token copy of the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token dies, triggering Faces of the Past, untapping all creatures that shared a creature type with it.
Repeat.
